user.title: Set up Connector Bridge
user.description: Find your API key in the Connector+ app: **Settings → About → tap 5 times anywhere**.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Connector Bridge
reconfigure.description: Update the bridge IP address or API key. The bridge must be reachable at the new address.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the bridge. Check the IP address and key.
error.invalid_key: Invalid API key. The key shown in the Connector+ app is exactly 16 characters long.

abort.not_connector_bridge: This device is not a Connector bridge.

init.title: Blind travel times
init.description: Full open/close travel time in seconds for each blind (by MAC address). Used to estimate position for motors that don't report one, so the state shows correctly in HomeKit.

move_for_duration.name: Move for duration
move_for_duration.description: Runs a blind in one direction for a set time, then stops it. Useful for nudging motors that cannot be sent to an exact position.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Whether to open or close the blind.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to run the motor, in seconds.

multicast_unavailable.title: Connector Bridge push updates unavailable
multicast_unavailable.description:
Home Assistant could not open the multicast socket used for real-time updates from the bridge, so it has fallen back to polling. Blind states will update more slowly and changes made with a physical remote may not be detected.

This usually means multicast traffic is blocked between Home Assistant and the bridge — common when Home Assistant runs in Docker with bridge networking, or when the bridge is on a different VLAN or subnet. Using host networking, or placing both on the same subnet, normally resolves it.

ip_changed.title: Connector Bridge IP address changed
ip_changed.description:
The bridge was not reachable at its previous address and was found again at {ip}. Home Assistant has updated the configuration automatically, so no action is required right now.

To stop this happening again, give the bridge a static IP address or a DHCP reservation in your router.
